After arranging the letters of the word.reason: MANAGEMENT has the letters M, A, N, A, G, E, M, E, N, T. In alphabetical order: A, A, E, E, G, M, M, N, N, T. Counting from the end: T (1st), N (2nd), N (3rd), so the third letter from the last is N.
After arranging the letters of the word.rel: MANAGEMENT has 10 letters: A, E, M and N appear twice each.

What is the motto given by the Quaid-e-A.reason: The Quaid-e-Azam gave the nation the motto Unity, Faith, Discipline (Ittehad, Yaqeen-e-Muhkam, Nazm). This is the order used in his speeches and in Pakistani textbooks.
What is the motto given by the Quaid-e-A.rel: In Urdu the motto is often written as Ittehad, Tanzeem, Yaqeen-e-Muhkam; some books change the order, but Unity, Faith, Discipline is the standard English form.

Who was elected Chief Minister of Khyber.rel: Since 11 October 2026 Khyber Pakhtunkhwa has been under governor's rule (Governor Faisal Karim Kundi), so the province has no sitting Chief Minister at the moment. In 2021-22 the answer was Mahmood Khan.
